transaction_unit: One whole net including all sink branches, tree-growth retries and budget rescue
execution: Distinct nets in a window search concurrently on one immutable authority snapshot. Each CPU proposal owns a private scratch state and per-lane search/quotient workspaces. All futures join before validation/publication begins.
order: Original net order: increasing first native task ID. Window width affects speculation only, not logical commit order.
reads: Every dynamic resource cost query, absent resources and off-path observations included; candidate portal occupancy and every written node also included. Sorted unique canonical node IDs refer to the initial window snapshot, before the proposal's own private tree growth.
validation: Same owner layout and present factor; exact input net tree; same resource version/history/net set for every recorded read. Changes outside the complete footprint do not invalidate a proposal.
publication: Recompute branch costs and validate read/write coverage and physical branches on a private copy of current authority. Apply all accepted branches there, then swap once. Late errors leave authority untouched. Stale proposals, including stale overflow, replay against current authority.
capacity: Negotiated-congestion semantics permit intermediate overuse; final convergence still requires zero overuse. This is not a strict concurrent capacity-grant protocol.

artifacts.transactions.csv: One row per initial/replayed whole-net proposal, immutable read range, conflict count, overflow, commit decision and all work counters
artifacts.readsets.bin: FPGAACCP shared 64-byte header, schema 0.1, object type 0x44520021, architecture fingerprint, CRC64-ECMA; 16-byte LE records {node:u32,reserved_zero:u32,snapshot_version:u64}
artifacts.proposals.csv: Every completed branch search, task/sink/pass/rescue, status, attachment, cost/hops and work
artifacts.proposal_paths.csv: Ordered canonical electrical nodes and directed PIP keys for every complete branch candidate
artifacts.transaction_passes.csv: Private shared-tree growth, failures and budget rescue/retry decisions
artifacts.conflicts.csv: All mismatching read nodes and snapshot/current versions, in canonical order
artifacts.execution.csv: Steady-clock begin/end for initial native proposals; analyzed for actual overlap, excluded from repeat byte equality
artifacts.accepted_work.csv: Only accepted proposal work, compared against serial baseline
artifacts.iterations.csv: All initial/discarded/replayed work, plus unchanged convergence statistics
artifacts.canonical_outputs: Same selection/trees/paths/connections/usage/owner_usage tables as serial native driver

limits: Mutable publication remains serial; no simultaneous writers or asynchronous owner service
Proposal scratch copies are CPU rollback buffers, not a hardware/HBM storage design
Die label RPC is unchanged within each proposal; this driver records its aggregate count, not a second per-packet capture
Recorded read/version replay is not an independent re-execution of search or proof of off-path read completeness
Thread intervals prove overlap only; no board, energy or isolated end-to-end speedup claim
Persistent delayed worker shadows, HBM/migration and full representative QoR remain open
